environment.description: Same Kubernetes deployment on EKS 1.28 in namespace 'prod-services'. Namespace has label pod-security.kubernetes.io/enforce: restricted (Pod Security Standards at restricted level). The pod spec uses securityContext with readOnlyRootFilesystem: true, runAsNonRoot: true, runAsUser: 65534, and allowPrivilegeEscalation: false. Volume mounts use projected volumes with subPath for /etc/keys/public.pem. Additionally, a Kyverno ClusterPolicy 'restrict-volume-types' limits volumes to configMap, secret, emptyDir, and projected only — no hostPath permitted. The container image is distroless (gcr.io/distroless/python3-debian12). An OPA Gatekeeper constraint K8sBlockHostPath is active cluster-wide.
